title: 第380章 大战一触即发第379章 后果不堪设想
content_zh:
第380章大战一触即发
“先回去休整，整理情报，规划一番再前往黑风岭。”
两人不再停留，转身离开危机四伏的赵家府邸。此刻，遥远的黑风岭地下魔窟。
阴冷潮湿的洞窟之内，一团翻滚的浓郁魔雾不断起伏。
正是侥幸退走的魔宗老祖，察觉到手下尽数陨落，魔雾剧烈翻腾，狂暴的怒火席卷整个洞窟。
“可恶！一个后辈修士，接连破坏我的计划，斩杀我的人手！”
苍老暴戾的声音在洞窟回荡，无数碎石从顶部簌簌掉落。
“阴煞大阵毁去，多年积攒的煞气损失大半，想要恢复身体伤势又要推迟许久。”
魔雾翻涌，魔宗老祖心中杀意升腾。
“既然软棋行不通，那便动用埋藏许久的后手。
张昊宇，你坏我大事，本座必定将你擒获，抽取你的本源灵力，弥补损失！”
洞窟深处，数道蛰伏已久的魔道气息缓缓苏醒，一场更大的危机，正在悄然酝酿。
翌日天明，青石镇风平浪静。
赵家一夜之间阵法崩毁、靠山尽亡，府中族人被阴煞侵体多日，心智昏聩、生机大损。
赵家家主得知所有真相，看着满地狼藉、死去的六尊邪修尸体，面如死灰，瘫坐在地，浑身瑟瑟发抖。
他倾尽家族财力、透支全族气运勾结魔道，到头来不仅没能报仇，反倒引火烧身，沦为魔宗滋养煞气的工具，险些葬送整个赵家。
张昊宇并未赶尽杀绝。
赵家凡人无辜，真正罪孽的是执迷不悟、私通邪祟的家主与几位族老。
他亲自出面，废除赵家残留的所有阴煞余毒，净化整座府邸的戾气。
同时废去赵家家主权位，禁足一众参与密谋的族老，令赵家余生闭门思过、行善积德，以此抵消过往罪孽。

经此一事，青石镇所有人都知晓，暗中潜藏的邪祟危机终于暂歇，人人心安。
而张昊宇与龙佳颖，已然做好奔赴黑风岭的全部准备。
临行前，张昊宇将从邪修口中打探到的所有情报细细梳理。
黑风岭，群山险恶、黑雾常年不散，地气阴寒至极，是方圆百里最浓郁的煞地，天然适合魔道修行。
魔宗老祖藏身地底魔窟，依靠迷魔阵遮蔽天机、隐匿踪迹。
外人就算闯入山岭，也只会在阵法中无尽打转，根本找不到真正入口。
且对方手下仍有十余散修邪徒在外收集煞气，随时可能作乱。
最关键的是——老祖隐忍百年，城府极深，昨夜吃了大亏，必定提前布下杀局，等候他们上门。
“此行凶险，不可轻敌。”
张昊宇也不用行囊，周身灵力凝练沉稳，气息收放自如。
龙佳颖紧随其侧，神色坚定：“无论前路如何，我与你同往。”
二人不再多言，张昊宇拉着龙佳颖的手，瞬移出院落，迎着清晨山风，直奔西方黑风岭。
黑风岭百里之外，天色早已不同于青石镇的晴朗明媚。
越靠近山岭，空气越发冰冷压抑，天空灰蒙蒙一片，草木枯黑，山石斑驳，连飞鸟走兽尽数绝迹，整片山脉死寂得令人心悸。
第380章大战一触即发
阵阵黑风穿林而过，带着刺骨的阴毒寒意，吹在皮肤上如同无数细针穿刺。
content_en:
Chapter 380 The war is about to break out
"Go back to rest first, sort out the information, and make some plans before heading to Black Wind Ridge."
The two of them stopped staying and turned to leave the Zhao family's mansion, which was full of dangers. At this moment, the distant Black Wind Ridge Underground Demon Cave.
In the cold and damp cave, a thick rolling mass of magic mist kept rising and falling.
It was the ancestor of the Demon Sect who was lucky enough to retreat. He noticed that all his men had died, the demonic mist was violently churning, and violent rage swept through the entire cave.
"Damn it! A junior monk is ruining my plans one after another and beheading my men!"
The old and violent voice echoed in the cave, and countless gravel fell from the top.
"With the Yin Evil Formation destroyed, most of the evil energy accumulated over the years has been lost, and recovery from physical injuries will have to be delayed for a long time."
The demonic mist surged, and the murderous intention rose in the demon sect ancestor's heart.
“Since soft chess doesn’t work, then use the backhand that has been buried for a long time.
Zhang Haoyu, if you ruin my life, I will definitely capture you and extract your original spiritual power to make up for the loss! "
Deep in the cave, several demonic auras that have been dormant for a long time are slowly awakening, and a greater crisis is quietly brewing.
It was dawn the next day, and everything was calm in Qingshi Town.
The Zhao family's formation collapsed overnight and their backers were wiped out. The clan members in the mansion were invaded by evil spirits for many days, causing their minds to become dim and their vitality greatly reduced.
After learning all the truth, the head of the Zhao family looked at the six dead corpses of evil cultivators scattered all over the ground. His face was ashen, and he sat slumped on the ground, trembling all over.
He spent all his family's financial resources and overdrafted the family's luck to collude with the devil. In the end, not only did he fail to take revenge, but he also set himself on fire and became a tool for the devil to nourish evil spirits, almost ruining the entire Zhao family.
Zhang Haoyu did not kill them all.
The mortals of the Zhao family are innocent, but the real sinners are the obsessive and evil head of the family and several clan elders.
He personally came forward to eliminate all the remaining evil spirits in the Zhao family and purify the entire mansion of the evil atmosphere.
At the same time, the title of head of the Zhao family was abolished, and a group of clan elders who participated in the conspiracy were banned. The Zhao family was forced to spend the rest of their lives behind closed doors, thinking about their mistakes, and doing good deeds to offset their past sins.
After this incident, everyone in Qingshi Town knew that the evil crisis lurking in the dark had finally come to an end, and everyone felt at ease.
Zhang Haoyu and Long Jiaying were already fully prepared to rush to Black Wind Ridge.
Before leaving, Zhang Haoyu carefully sorted out all the information he had gleaned from the evil cultivators.
Black Wind Ridge has dangerous mountains, black mist that persists all year round, and extremely cold air. It is the strongest evil place within a hundred miles, and is naturally suitable for the practice of magic.
The ancestor of the demon sect hides in the underground demon cave, relying on the magic array to cover up the secrets and hide his traces.
Even if outsiders break into the mountain, they will only wander endlessly in the formation and cannot find the real entrance.
Moreover, the opponent still has more than ten evil cultivators out there collecting evil spirits, who may cause chaos at any time.
The most important thing is - the ancestor has been patient for hundreds of years, the city is extremely deep, and he suffered a big loss last night, so he must have laid a killing plan in advance, waiting for them to come.
"This trip is dangerous, don't underestimate the enemy."
Zhang Haoyu doesn't need to carry a bag. His spiritual power is condensed and steady, and his breath can be freely released.
Long Jiaying followed closely, with a firm look on her face: "No matter what the road ahead is, I will go with you."
The two of them said nothing more. Zhang Haoyu took Long Jiaying's hand and teleported out of the courtyard. Facing the morning mountain wind, he headed straight to the Black Wind Ridge in the west.
A hundred miles away from Heifeng Ridge, the sky was already different from the clear and bright sky in Qingshi Town.
The closer we got to the mountains, the air became colder and more oppressive, the sky was gray, the vegetation was black, the rocks were mottled, and even the birds and animals were extinct. The entire mountain range was so deathly silent that it was heart-stopping.
Chapter 380 The war is about to break out
Bursts of black wind passed through the forest, carrying a biting and sinister chill, blowing on the skin like countless fine needles puncturing it.
